english:
Dealing Kinetic Weapon damage and scoring Kinetic Weapon kills progresses a 125 point counter, which spawns a unique Kinetic Ammo Brick at 100%.

The counter lasts 15 seconds and is refreshed by Kinetic Weapon damage.

Each damage point grants 0.03% progress, so 3770 damage is required per brick. A499 generates 75% less progress (15K damage per brick).

Kill progress based on <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Rank-and-File: 8%
• Elites: 16%
• Minibosses: 32%
• Champions and higher: 100%

The damage requirement ignores Power Delta but counts actual damage dealt, so the same base damage is needed even when Power Level differences reduce your damage.

Collecting a Kinetic Ammo Brick grants 5% Special and 5% Heavy Ammo Progress, refills the magazines of equipped Kinetic Weapons, and generates Special and Heavy ammo for them equal to 1/3 of a magazine plus 1 ammo.

Ammo generation exceptions:
• Bastion grants 1 additional ammo
• Cull's Shadow grants 2 additional ammo
• Praxic grants 2 additional ammo
• Microcosm grants 12 additional ammo

Bricks count for Ammo Pickup effects, and Kinetic Ammo Generation is unaffected by Scavenger Bricks. A brick cannot directly spawn another brick.
